# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge
To foster a welcoming environment, interaction in this repository must be a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of background, experience, or identity.

## Expected Behavior
* Respectful and professional communication
* Focusing on factual data when reporting bugs
* Gracefully accepting maintainer decisions

## Unacceptable Behavior
* Trolling, insulting, or derogatory comments
* Personal or political attacks
* Public or private harassment

## Enforcement
As the sole maintainer, I reserve the right to close issues, delete comments, or block users who violate these standards.
